The capital city of India is New Delhi.

Some additional key facts about the capital of India:

- New Delhi is the capital of both India and the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

- It serves as the seat of the Government of India and the Government of the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

- New Delhi was established in 1911 as the capital of British India, replacing Calcutta (now Kolkata) which had served as the capital since 1773.

- New Delhi was planned and built by British architects Edwin Lutyens and Herbert Baker.

- The official residence of the President of India, Rashtrapati Bhavan, is located in New Delhi, as are several other important government buildings and landmarks.

- New Delhi is one of the fastest growing cities in the world and is home to over 29 million people in its metropolitan area, making it the second largest city in India after Mumbai.

So in summary, the capital city of the Republic of India is New Delhi, located in the northern part of the country.
